# Sirach Chapter 50 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalent)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 50 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**50:1** Simon son of Onias the priest — who in his lifetime repaired the house of God, and in his days strengthened the temple;

**50:2** who laid the foundations of the great double wall, the high retaining wall of the temple precinct;

**50:3** who in his days had a vast cistern cut — a reservoir as broad as the sea —

**50:4** who cared for his people against raiders and reinforced the city against enemies.

**50:5** How magnificent he was when the people surrounded him as he came out from behind the curtain of the sanctuary!

**50:6** Like the morning star shining through the clouds, like the full moon on a festival day,

**50:7** like the sun blazing on the temple of the Most High, like a rainbow glowing in glorious clouds,

**50:8** like a rose in first-fruits season, like a lily by a spring, like a branch of frankincense on a summer's day,

**50:9** like fire and incense rising from the censer, like a vessel of beaten gold encrusted with every kind of precious stone,

**50:10** like an olive tree heavy with harvest, like a cypress rising tall toward the clouds —

**50:11** how glorious he was as he donned his magnificent vestments and robed himself in the fullness of splendor, as he stepped up to the holy altar and filled the temple precinct with his glory!

**50:12** When he received the portions from the hands of the priests, standing there by the blazing altar, his brothers surrounding him in a living crown, he was like a young cedar of Lebanon ringed by palm trunks.

**50:13** All the sons of Aaron in their splendor stood with the Lord's fire-offerings in their hands, before the whole congregation of Israel.

**50:14** When he had completed the altar service and set in order the offering to the Almighty Most High,

**50:15** he stretched out his hand to the cup of libation and poured out the blood of the grape; he poured it out at the base of the altar — a fragrant offering to the Most High, King of all.

**50:16** Then the sons of Aaron shouted and sounded their metal trumpets in a great ringing blast, a call remembered before the Most High.

**50:17** All the people at once bowed down on the ground, falling on their faces to worship before the Most High, before the Holy One of Israel.

**50:18** The singing rang out, and the sound of it was made sweet over the great crowd.

**50:19** All the people of the land prayed and petitioned before the merciful Lord until the worship of the Lord was finished and his service completed.

**50:20** Then Simon came down and raised his hands over the whole congregation of Israel; the blessing of the Lord was on his lips, and he gloried in the name of the Lord.

**50:21** And the people bowed down a second time to receive the blessing from the Most High.

**50:22** Now, bless the God of all — who in every way does great things, who has exalted our days from birth and dealt with us according to his mercy.

**50:23** May he give us joy of heart; may there be peace in Israel in our days, and may the faithfulness of Israel endure forever.

**50:24** May his mercy be with us always, and may he rescue us in our days!

**50:25** My soul is fed up with two nations, and a third is no nation at all:

**50:26** the inhabitants of the hill country of Seir, and the Philistines, and the stupid people living in Shechem.

**50:27** Understanding and knowledge, instruction in wisdom — I have written all this in this book: I, Jesus son of Sirach, son of Eleazar, of Jerusalem, who poured it all out like rain.

**50:28** Blessed is the one who reads these things; whoever takes them to heart will grow wise.

**50:29** If anyone puts them into practice, they will be strong enough for anything; for the light of the Lord is their path.
